_comment: One problem, six pieces of solving it, and every piece is the input to the next. The lamp you sweep finds the trench mouth; the floats you sort BECOME the lift; the currents you turn carry the lift down; the lights you gather are strung on Sadaf's shell; her glow is what lets you see the wall to draw on; the line you draw is what shows you the gate; the beat you hear is what opens it. Take any one away and the chapter stops.
_shapeComment: Six activities, not the Market's seven. The Market's own report flagged its length as an untested bet, and attention at four to five runs eight to twelve minutes. Six lands inside that with the story beats included.
_agencyComment: Sadaf carries, but she cannot hear the beat and says so. The climax is the child's: they give the rhythm back from memory, the gate opens, and she goes through on the beat they played. The Market let an adult resolve its ending; this one does not.

lines.en: The page did not land on the sand. It went over the reef edge, into the dark.
lines.ar: لَمْ تَسْقُطِ الصَّفْحَةُ عَلَى الرَّمْل. عَبَرَتْ حَافَّةَ الشِّعَابِ إِلَى الظَّلَام.

lines.en: A young turtle saw it go. Her name is Sadaf, and she has never been down there.
lines.ar: رَأَتْهَا سُلَحْفَاةٌ صَغِيرَةٌ وَهِيَ تَهْوِي. اِسْمُهَا صَدَف، وَلَمْ تَنْزِلْ هُنَاكَ قَطّ.

lines.en: Under the reef edge there is no daylight left. Take the lamp and look.
lines.ar: تَحْتَ حَافَّةِ الشِّعَابِ لَا يَبْقَى ضَوْءُ النَّهَار. خُذِ المِصْبَاحَ وَانْظُر.

lines.en: Nothing reaches the trench by hand. The storm left enough here to build a lift.
lines.ar: لَا شَيْءَ يَصِلُ إِلَى الأُخْدُودِ بِاليَد. وَتَرَكَتِ العَاصِفَةُ هُنَا مَا يَكْفِي لِبِنَاءِ رَافِعَة.

lines.en: The floats hold. Nobody swims down a trench: you ride the water that is already going there.
lines.ar: صَمَدَتِ العَوَّامَات. وَلَا أَحَدَ يَسْبَحُ إِلَى الأُخْدُود؛ بَلْ تَرْكَبُ المَاءَ النَّازِل.

lines.en: The basket is down. Sadaf is beside it, waiting on the trench floor.
lines.ar: وَصَلَتِ السَّلَّةُ. وَصَدَفُ بِجِوَارِهَا تَنْتَظِرُ عَلَى قَاعِ الأُخْدُود.

lines.en: Down here there is no light at all. None.
lines.ar: وَهُنَا فِي الأَسْفَلِ لَا ضَوْءَ عَلَى الإِطْلَاق. وَلَا ذَرَّة.

lines.en: Glow-weed grows along this ledge. Sadaf will carry whatever you give her.
lines.ar: يَنْمُو العُشْبُ المُضِيءُ عَلَى هَذِهِ الحَافَّة. وَصَدَفُ سَتَحْمِلُ كُلَّ مَا تُعْطِيهَا.

lines.en: Her glow reaches the trench wall. Drag the light along it and it stays.
lines.ar: يَبْلُغُ تَوَهُّجُهَا جِدَارَ الأُخْدُود. اِسْحَبِ الضَّوْءَ عَلَيْهِ فَيَثْبُت.

lines.en: A gate of reef, and the sea is tapping at it. Sadaf cannot hear the beat. You can.
lines.ar: بَوَّابَةٌ مِنَ الشِّعَاب، وَالبَحْرُ يَطْرُقُهَا. صَدَفُ لَا تَسْمَعُ الإِيقَاع. أَنْتَ تَسْمَعُه.

lines.en: Past the gate, caught on the wall you lit, right where nobody was searching.
lines.ar: خَلْفَ البَوَّابَة، عَالِقَةً عَلَى الجِدَارِ الَّذِي أَضَأْتَه، حَيْثُ لَمْ يَبْحَثْ أَحَد.

lines.en: The basket brings it up, and Sadaf follows the shells home: the Blue Page.
lines.ar: تَرْفَعُهَا السَّلَّة، وَتَتْبَعُ صَدَفُ الصَّدَفَاتِ عَائِدَة: الصَّفْحَةُ الزَّرْقَاء.

lines.en: On this page it is night, and the sky is full of small cold lights.
lines.ar: عَلَى هَذِهِ الصَّفْحَةِ لَيْل، وَالسَّمَاءُ مَلِيئَةٌ بِأَضْوَاءٍ صَغِيرَةٍ بَارِدَة.
